title: Penrose!
html_source: The name “of that priestylooking chap was always squinting in when he passed?” comes to Bloom.

anchor.prefix: idea of Dublin he must have, tapping his way round by the stones. Could he walk in a beeline if he hadn't that cane? Bloodless pious face like a fellow going in to be a priest.
anchor.suffix:
That was that chap's name.
